explanation: Bishop, Knight, Rook, and Queen are all chess pieces that can move more than one square in a single turn. A Pawn typically moves only one square forward (or two on its initial move) and is thus the odd one out.

category: The Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
explanation: The Colosseum is a renowned Roman amphitheater and a famous ancient landmark, but it is not one of the traditionally recognized Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. The other four tokens are all conventionally listed as original Seven Wonders.
Scarred contains 'red', Whitewash contains 'white', Blacksmith contains 'black', and Greenery contains 'green'. Yellow is itself a color, rather than a word that contains a color's name.
